about: Bundled reading fragments for Conjunction's deterministic fallback readings (used when the on-device model is unavailable). Shared byte-for-byte by Android (:core resources) and iOS (ConjunctionCore resources). Entertainment only: no certainty, no health, financial or legal advice.

It sits in the 2nd house, linked with comfort, values and what you cherish.
It sits in the 3rd house, busy with words, siblings, neighbors and short journeys.
It sits in the 4th house, rooted in home, family and private memory.
It sits in the 5th house, where play, romance and creativity take the stage.
It sits in the 6th house, woven into routines, craft and daily service.
It sits in the 7th house, mirrored in partners and close one-to-one bonds.
It sits in the 8th house, drawn to depth, trust and shared resources.
It sits in the 9th house, reaching for travel, study and big ideas.
It sits in the 10th house, visible in vocation and public reputation.
It sits in the 11th house, alive in friendships, groups and future hopes.
It sits in the 12th house, working quietly through dreams and solitude.

transit.conjunction: Transiting {transit} meets your natal {natal}, a moment to begin something with intention.
transit.sextile: Transiting {transit} sextiles your natal {natal}, so a small, friendly opportunity may appear if you reach for it.
transit.square: Transiting {transit} squares your natal {natal}; treat any friction as a nudge to adjust rather than a wall.
transit.trine: Transiting {transit} trines your natal {natal}, an easy current that rewards going with the flow.
transit.opposition: Transiting {transit} opposes your natal {natal}, inviting you to weigh both sides before you choose.

daily.quietSky: No tight transits press on your chart today, which leaves room to set your own rhythm.
closings: Let the evening be gentle and keep one small promise to yourself.
A thoughtful pause before you answer could be the day's quiet gift.
Notice what makes you laugh; it is pointing somewhere worth going.
Trust your pace - gold leaf is applied one careful sheet at a time.
Share a kind word; it may travel further than you expect.
Tidy one corner of your world and watch the rest feel lighter.
Look up tonight; the same stars are keeping you company.
Choose the brave, kind option and let the rest unfold.

risingUnknown: Your rising sign depends on the exact minute you were born. Add your birth time in your profile whenever you learn it, and this doorway of your chart will open.
natalClosing: Treat this as a mirror for reflection rather than a map of fate: the stars describe a mood, and you choose the steps.

chinese.yearVsLunar: Because you were born between the lunar new year and Lichun (or the other way round), the popular lunar calendar calls you a {lunarAnimal} while the solar BaZi year is the {yearAnimal}; many readers enjoy both.

a.title: Type A - The Careful Gardener
a.strengths: Popular ketsueki-gata lore paints Type A as thoughtful planners who notice what others need and keep their word.
a.growth: The lore suggests letting go of perfect timing and allowing yourself to rest before everything is finished.
a.love: In love, Type A is said to show devotion through steady, attentive care.
a.work: At work, the lore casts Type A as the reliable organizer whose details make plans succeed.

b.title: Type B - The Free Spirit
b.strengths: Popular lore sees Type B as curious, enthusiastic and refreshingly true to their own interests.
b.growth: The lore suggests finishing one passion before chasing the next shiny horizon.
b.love: In love, Type B is said to be playful, spontaneous and wholehearted.
b.work: At work, the lore casts Type B as the original thinker who dives deep into what fascinates them.

ab.title: Type AB - The Moonlit Enigma
ab.strengths: Popular lore describes Type AB as a blend of A's calm and B's flair: cool-headed, artistic and hard to pin down.
ab.growth: The lore suggests letting people see your warmth as well as your poise.
ab.love: In love, Type AB is said to be considerate, witty and to value personal space.
ab.work: At work, the lore casts Type AB as the level-headed mediator with a creative streak.

o.title: Type O - The Warm Captain
o.strengths: Popular lore sees Type O as sociable, resilient and naturally encouraging leaders.
o.growth: The lore suggests slowing down to hear the quieter voices in the crew.
o.love: In love, Type O is said to be affectionate, protective and openly expressive.
o.work: At work, the lore casts Type O as the motivator who rallies people toward a shared goal.

bloodIntro: Blood-type personality (ketsueki-gata) is a popular East Asian folk tradition with no scientific basis; enjoy it as a playful lens.

shapes.earth: Your square palm and shorter fingers suggest an Earth hand in palmistry folklore: practical, grounded and happiest making real things.
shapes.air: Your square palm and longer fingers suggest an Air hand in palmistry folklore: curious, communicative and quick to connect ideas.
shapes.fire: Your longer palm and shorter fingers suggest a Fire hand in palmistry folklore: energetic, spontaneous and driven by enthusiasm.
shapes.water: Your longer palm and longer fingers suggest a Water hand in palmistry folklore: sensitive, imaginative and deeply intuitive.

heart.long: A long heart line is read as an open, expressive heart.
heart.medium: A balanced heart line is read as warmth tempered by good judgment.
heart.short: A shorter heart line is read as someone who shows love through actions more than words.
heart.curved: Its upward curve is said to belong to a romantic who follows feeling.
heart.straight: Its straight path is said to belong to a calm, steady lover.
heart.absent: The heart line was hard to make out in this photo.

head.long: A long head line is read as a thorough thinker who enjoys exploring every angle.
head.medium: A balanced head line is read as clear, practical thinking.
head.short: A shorter head line is read as a decisive mind that prefers action to theory.
head.curved: Its gentle slope is said to point toward imagination and creative thought.
head.straight: Its straight run is said to point toward logic and focus.
head.absent: The head line was hard to make out in this photo.

life.long: A long, sweeping life line is read as abundant enthusiasm for experience - palmists say its length describes vitality of spirit, not length of life.
life.medium: A balanced life line is read as steady, sustainable energy.
life.short: A shorter life line is read as independence and self-direction - palmists say it says nothing about how long anyone lives.
life.curved: Its wide arc is said to show warmth and a love of company.
life.straight: Its close, straight path is said to show a reserved, self-contained nature.
life.absent: The life line was hard to make out in this photo.

fate.long: A clear fate line is read as a strong sense of purpose and direction.
fate.medium: A partial fate line is read as a path that becomes clearer with time.
fate.short: A short fate line is read as a life shaped more by choice than by script.
fate.curved: Its wandering course is said to reflect a varied, self-made path.
fate.straight: Its straight course is said to reflect steady dedication.
fate.absent: No fate line stood out, which palmists read as freedom to write your own story.

depth.deep: The {line} line looks deep and well defined.
depth.faint: The {line} line looks fine and delicate.

fingers.indexLonger: Your index finger is longer than your ring finger, which palmists link to confidence and a taste for leadership.
fingers.ringLonger: Your ring finger is longer than your index finger, which palmists link to creativity and a love of risk.
fingers.even: Your index and ring fingers are nearly even, which palmists link to a balanced temperament.

palm.intro: Palmistry is a centuries-old folk art, offered here purely for fun.
palm.closing: Your hands keep changing as you live, and so does your story.
